readmeSummary: Provides focused child Pi sessions, foreground/background delegation, scripted multi-agent workflows, structured outputs, run observability and a public extension RPC/delegation API.
envReads: PATH and PATHEXT for optional LSP diagnostics
optional MCP bearer-token environment names selected by explicit MCP configuration
networkAccess: No direct HTTP client was found in the core extension paths reviewed
Child Pi sessions can call configured model providers and any explicitly allowed network-capable tools
fileWrites: Child session, status, transcript and structured-output artifacts
Optional project .pi-subagents missions, schedules, refinements and worktrees
Optional user agent/config paths when administrative commands are explicitly invoked
processExecution: Optional git worktree and LSP subprocesses
The package bin installer can clone or remove a user-level extension, but it is not an npm lifecycle script and is not invoked by this project
promptInjectionRisk: Child agents receive focused task prompts and selected context. Risk is reduced in this project by project-owned meeting agent definitions with a read-only tool allowlist, bounded evidence paths, stable schemas and parent reconciliation.
credentialHandling: The package inherits the parent process environment so model-provider credentials remain available to child Pi sessions. Meeting child agents are denied shell/write/orchestration tools; credentials must never be placed in prompts, results or artifacts.
disableOrUninstallPath: Remove the node_modules/pi-subagents resource paths and dependency from meeting-agent-pi-package/package.json, reinstall dependencies, then reload Pi.
smokeEvidence: Pi 0.84.1 RPC loaded the package from ../meeting-agent-pi-package after validating that project package paths resolve relative to .pi

subagents doctor reported async support available and discovered four project meeting specialists
single-review plans use the 0.46 workflowScript + runs.run(...) execution contract with fresh context and structured output
A real DeepSeek parent run observed read then subagent tool_execution_end and completed meeting-action-reviewer against synthetic meeting evidence
